name: splitbrief-website

scripts.build: npm run invalidate:built && npm run check:content && npm run check:links && npm run check:licenses && npm run generate:metadata && vite build && npm run generate:og && npm run check:og && vite build && npm run generate:csp && npm run check:artifacts && npm run record:built
scripts.build:container: npm run invalidate:built && npm run check:content && npm run check:links && npm run check:licenses && npm run generate:metadata && npm run check:og && vite build && npm run generate:csp && npm run check:artifacts && npm run record:built
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate:source && npm run generate:routes && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run generate:source && npm run generate:routes && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:built
scripts.lighthouse: npm run build && npm run lighthouse:built
scripts.verify:origin: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:content && npm run check:links && npm run check:licenses && npm run audit:production
scripts.verify:production: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:built && npm run lighthouse:built

description: Static landing and documentation app for SPLITBRIEF. TanStack Start prerenders the site, and headless Fumadocs supplies the documentation model. The deployable output is `dist/client`; `dist/server` is build-time-only.
